name: FRD Orchestrator
description: An MCP server that exposes structured Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) to enable AI assistants like GitHub Copilot to automatically generate complete NestJS boilerplate architectures. It orchestrates the multi-phase creation of production-ready APIs including core CRUD, database integration, JWT authentication, and unit testing.
